pages.beforeParagraph: Kineo (usekineo.com) is an AI faceless YouTube Shorts generator: type one topic or paste your own script and it returns a finished vertical Short — script, AI voiceover, AI-generated scenes, burned-in captions and music — with no filming, no face on camera and no timeline to edit. A 60-second faceless Short costs 35 credits on Seedance 1.5 (about $4.43); plans start at $9/month. Prices as of 9 October 2026.
pages.afterParagraph: A finished 60-second narrated MiniMax H3 Turbo Short uses 35 credits on Kineo. Starter lists $9 USD per month for 40 credits. Compare that assembled film with the same duration and included voice, captions and music, rather than a raw clip rate. Other creations and extra attempts use the same balance.

pages.beforeParagraph: What you get: a mini documentary with narration and period-accurate scenes. What you write: one idea or a full script. Kineo does the script, the voice, the scenes, the captions and the music.
pages.afterParagraph: Kineo assembles a narrated documentary Short from a topic or narration script: generated scenes, voice, captions, music and a vertical MP4. Use your researched narration when wording and facts matter. Generated scenes are reconstructions, not archive evidence; verify names, dates and claims and review the film before publishing.

pages.beforeParagraph: Escribe una idea y Kineo genera el Short vertical completo: guion, narración en español, escenas y subtítulos — listo para YouTube Shorts, TikTok o Reels. Sin tarjeta.
pages.afterParagraph: Kineo crea un video vertical desde una idea o un guion en español, con escenas generadas, voz, subtítulos y música. No necesitas grabarte ni mostrar tu propia cara. Revisa narración, hechos y continuidad antes de subir el MP4; las personas generadas pueden aparecer y variar entre escenas.

pages.beforeParagraph: What you get: a narrated video with no presenter on screen. What you write: one idea or a full script. Kineo does the script, the voice, the scenes, the captions and the music.
pages.afterParagraph: Choose by the job you need done. Kineo builds a narrated faceless Short from a topic or supplied narration: generated scenes, voice, captions and music in a vertical MP4. You do not have to film yourself. Generated people can still appear, so review faces, facts and continuity before posting; no audience result is guaranteed.

pages.beforeParagraph: Kineo turns a horror idea or creepy legend into a faceless vertical Short with a script, AI voiceover, captions and generated scenes. In supported countries, new accounts receive 10 trial credits for one watermarked 15-second Kling 4.0 / MiniMax H3 Turbo film. Paid plans start at US$9 monthly and provide clean downloads.
pages.afterParagraph: Kineo turns a horror idea or narration script into a vertical story video with generated scenes, voice, captions and music. Start with what happens and how it ends; review the finished narration and images before posting. Treat invented horror as fiction, and do not assume every scene or character will be visually perfect.

pages.beforeParagraph: Kineo is one option for complete faceless Shorts from text, with narration, visuals and captions, a 10-credit no-card trial and Starter at $9/month.
pages.afterParagraph: Kineo is an InVideo alternative for a specific job: turning a topic or narration script into an assembled faceless Short with scenes, voice, captions and music. It does not import an InVideo project. Compare that finished-film workflow with the editing or repurposing task you actually need, then check the selected duration and credits.

pages.beforeParagraph: Sim. Escreva uma ideia ou cole o roteiro em português: a Kineo cria um Short faceless com cenas, narração em português do Brasil, legendas, música e MP4 vertical. A amostra tem marca d’água e depende da elegibilidade regional; confira o custo antes de gerar.
pages.afterParagraph: Sim. A Kineo monta vídeos sem aparecer a partir de ideia ou roteiro em português, inclusive histórias de terror, com cenas, narração, legendas e música. Você não precisa se filmar. Confira a pronúncia, as imagens e o desfecho antes de postar; apresente histórias inventadas como ficção.

pages.beforeParagraph: Kineo turns an idea or a narration script into a vertical story with generated scenes, voice, captions and music using MiniMax H3 Turbo. A 60-second story costs 35 credits, with paid plans starting at $9/month for 40 monthly credits.
pages.afterParagraph: Kineo can make a narrated story from an idea or your script, but it does not guarantee a recurring character will keep the same appearance across scenes or episodes. Review faces, clothing, hands and continuity in the finished film. If guaranteed cast identity is essential, do not treat an assembled story as proof that requirement is met.

pages.beforeParagraph: Escribe una historia de miedo — la regla de las 3 de la mañana, la casa del pueblo que nadie visita, la llamada desde un número que no existe — y Kineo la convierte en un video vertical narrado en español, con subtítulos y escenas generadas por IA. Sin grabar, sin editar y sin mostrar la cara.
pages.afterParagraph: Kineo convierte una idea de terror o un guion en un video vertical narrado en español, con escenas, subtítulos y música. Escribe el lugar, lo que ocurre y el desenlace; revisa voz e imágenes antes de subirlo. Presenta las historias inventadas como ficción y no prometas hechos que no has comprobado.

pages.beforeParagraph: Yes. Kineo turns an idea or narration script into a finished vertical MP4 with generated scenes, an AI voice, captions and background music. Use an idea when you want AI to write the script, or the script field when you already have the spoken words. Review facts, pronunciation and visual continuity before posting; generation time varies by film and engine.
pages.afterParagraph: Use the script workflow when the spoken words are already yours. Supply narration rather than camera directions, review it in Studio and generate the scenes, voice, captions and music around that input. Check the final voice and captions before posting; a topic-only request asks AI to write a new script instead.
